title: fix(compile.ts): ShapeDisplayObject with cacheAsBitmap AND colorEffect drops colorEffect
description:
In compile.ts (packages/swf/src/compile.ts), the initial placement branch for ShapeDisplayObject checks conditions in this order:

  1. hasFilters → PlaceObject3 with filters (passes cxform correctly)
  2. hasBlend → PlaceObject3 with blend mode
  3. cacheAsBitmap → PlaceObject3WithCacheAsBitmap   ← BUG: no cxform
  4. colorEffect || visible===false || alpha!=1 → PlaceObject2WithCXForm

Because cacheAsBitmap (branch 3, lines ~1825-1833) is checked BEFORE colorEffect (branch 4, lines ~1835-1852), a shape that has BOTH cacheAsBitmap=true AND a colorEffect will take branch 3 and call:
  encodePlaceObject3WithCacheAsBitmap(charId, depth, x, y, objTransform)
WITHOUT passing the colorEffect as a cxform argument. The function signature accepts an optional cxform?: CXForm as the last parameter (filters.ts line 853), but it is not passed, so HasColorTransform=0 and the color effect is silently dropped.

The same gap exists in the posChanged/move path in compile.ts (around lines 2288-2345) -- there is no handling for shape+cacheAsBitmap+colorEffect on move at all; the cacheAsBitmap+move path is absent (only the initial placement has it).

Fix:
1. In the initial-placement cacheAsBitmap branch (~line 1825), compute the CXForm from colorEffect/visible/alpha before calling encodePlaceObject3WithCacheAsBitmap, and pass it as the final argument:
   const shapeCacheCXForm = (compute from colorEffect/visible/alpha, same pattern as lines 1784-1845);
   encodePlaceObject3WithCacheAsBitmap(charId, depth, x, y, objTransform, shapeCacheCXForm)
2. In the posChanged branch, add a cacheAsBitmap+shape case similar to compile.ts's instance cacheAsBitmap+move path (lines 2152-2165), also passing the cxform.

Acceptance: unit test with a shape display object having cacheAsBitmap=true and colorEffect={type:'tint',...} compiled via the full compile() pipeline; assert PlaceObject3 body has HasCacheAsBitmap (flags2 bit 2) set AND HasColorTransform (flags1 bit 3) set with correct CXFORMWITHALPHA bytes.
